behavior.guard_entry: Current nonzero mode saves supplied renderer then actual B33AD0 AL, before any identity read or base write. Entry exception leaves cleanup unarmed.
behavior.outer_identity: Read current renderer+17B8 against original input, arm state0, always write renderer+17BC base; branch on captured comparison.
behavior.inner_identity: On outer change reload current renderer+17B8 and compare again. Inner identity skips reference changes but still reaches getter, SetIndices and counter.
behavior.replace: Publish original input before its real LONG+04 InterlockedIncrement; then captured old LONG+04 InterlockedDecrement. On zero read current logical profile/slot0 BD30E0, reread current logical profile/slot+04 B4C1F0 and invoke complete actual deleting provider with flag1.
behavior.getter: Original nonnull input reads current logical D61DE0 profile/slot+28 token B48DC0; adapter reads current logical+08 physical, current physical D61E10 or D61E58 profile, slot+1C token B4B840, then full actual physical leaf reads +28.
behavior.device: After getter or null result read current renderer+1A10 device, then its current COM table, then +1A0 SetIndices. The same captured current device is receiver. HRESULT ignored.
behavior.counter: Current DWORD renderer+1BB8 wraps after SetIndices returns. No counter on outer identity or exceptions before COM return.
behavior.EH: CBD058 full10 handler, DF56EC full36 FuncInfo, DF56E4 full8 unwind map state0->-1/action CBD050. Full8 CBD050 uses guard EBP-14 and actual B21110. No rollback.
behavior.normal_leave: Read current mode, disarm cleanup, then conditional actual B33B00 with retained entry renderer. Its ignored argument uses the defined AL byte, leaving native padding semantically unused.
behavior.secondary_exception: C++ cleanup exception E06D7363 terminates during search; native/source isolated terminal state matches.
behavior.uninitialized_guard: Disabled entry leaves native guard storage indeterminate; entry-disabled/exit-enabled mode transition remains outside the native valid domain.

functions.suggested_Ghidra_comment: Full236-byte actual raw renderer index binding reconstructed. Optional entry precedes outer +17B8 identity read; arm cleanup then always write base+17BC. On outer change reload old and compare again, publish/increment original input then decrement captured old. At zero current logical slot0 BD30E0 rereads current deleting slot B4C1F0 flag1; full actual logical/physical lifetime providers. Original nonnull input current +28 B48DC0 -> current physical+08/current table+1C B4B840. Null calls SetIndices(NULL). Device/current table loaded after getter, call +1A0; ignore HRESULT; +1BB8 increment only on return. FH3 CBD058/DF56EC/DF56E4/CBD050 guard cleanup only, disarm before normal leave. Explicit original-token table views never host call targets. New C++ ABI, private actual-D3D9 native/source comparison passed, not game validated.

functions.suggested_Ghidra_comment: Existing full10-byte naked B48DC0 entry retained unchanged for relocated callable physical tables. Added complete original-token adapter get_native_logical_index_buffer_00b48dc0 in native_renderer_index_binding.cpp: current logical+08 physical, current D61E10/D61E58 table selector, borrowed immutable eight-DWORD table+1C B4B840 token, then actual full4-byte physical getter. The same profile views serve full logical/physical lifetime. Numeric game addresses never become host call targets. Full original body and actual provider match fresh Ghidra/PE; private actual-D3D9 original/source comparison includes current-profile mutation and standalone adapter result. New context-bound C++ ABI.
